summary:
Independent CF1/CF3/CF5 source-entitlement audit obtained a legitimate author-primary witness after the earlier intake had found no author copy. Koons’s own Discovery article https://www.discovery.org/a/140/ explicitly links the archived UT faculty cosmo.pdf; its source_url is the fixed archived original https://web.archive.org/web/20000902170203id_/http://www.dla.utexas.edu/depts/philosophy/faculty/koons/cosmo.pdf . Raw PDF295689bytes SHA256c0dba715d1e362084217106bfc26ec686e841e28eb052edb72afae00cc9f2c59. The26page author preprint is dated18December1996; PDF creation metadata31July1997. Journal bibliographic orientation identifies APQ34(2),1997,pp193–211(JSTOR20009892), while the author’s current publication list gives171–92. This discrepancy is not silently resolved or used to equate editions. Source witness/locators explicitly name PREPRINT pagination; old Koons2001 evidence, claims and blocked live endpoint are untouched. Source_evidence.materialize KOONS-NEW-LOOK-PREPRINT-1996-FULL completed55919 with exact raw/text pins; verified text .cache/truth-core/sources/KOONS-NEW-LOOK-PREPRINT-1996-FULL.txt SHA25606555114c90249cfb0fa94bc2d608eb494aed2618ba113c39ede724bdab6d7cb. Re-read verified full argument §§3–6.2pp3–9 and §7corollaries1–7pp9–11, plus §8.4–8.6pp15–17 after materialization; earlier bounded availability reading also read full argument/objectionspp1–23. DOMAIN: §3pp3–5 distinguishes possible concrete facts/events/states of affairs from propositions, fixes the possible-facts domain, and states T with Barcan/converse-Barcan. Fact aggregates are not arbitrary individual-bearer fusions by their names. §7Corollary1pp9–10 separately assumes every fact involves some being/property and involvement in an actual fact implies actual bearer existence; source fact-to-individual/rigid witness interpretation remains an added semantic obligation, not automatic necessity of a concrete individual or God. FUSION/CF1: §3p3Axiom2 is type aggregation; §3p4Axiom4 is BOXED whole-obtaining→part-obtaining, stronger than merely local part existence. §8.5p16 explicitly treats nonempty wholly-contingent-fact aggregation as the crucial global commitment and argues that basic concrete fact totalities avoid problematic higher-order totalities. This is positive source argument, not a mechanically established actual selected-sum/type or possible-fact-to-individual dictionary. In §6.2p8Lemma2 the selected aggregate of necessary parts is introduced and the contingent original is then said not to be part of it; the source does not separately display the selected aggregate’s necessity. Our SelectedNecessaryPartsFusionAt remains an explicit analyst warrant; it is not independently discharged by local A5, nor should absence of a displayed step be reported as a refutation of every charitable reconstruction. Axiom4 does support the shape of modal downward necessity used by source Lemma1, but its world/domain correspondence still needs a separate application. NONOVERLAP/CF5: §4p5Axiom6 motivates nonoverlap through Hume’s separate-existences insight, precision in fact mereology, and expressly excludes only shared FACT parts, not spatial/temporal overlap. No additional independent derivation of this universal nonoverlap restriction was found in the read argument/objections. Numerical inequality or ordinary body separation is not silently substituted. CAUSALCOVERAGE/CF3: §4pp5–6Axiom7 states universal wholly-contingent-fact causal coverage; §5.1p6 admits empirical evidence cannot settle all exceptions and argues at least a DEFAULT license absent positive contrary evidence. §5.2pp6–7 offers empirical-success/non-gerrymandered-class and skepticism arguments; §8.1p13 rejects requiring observations of universes specifically and defends default application to the cosmos. These are source arguments to assess, not a proof of exceptionless CF3 or automatic defeat of the strongest domain/reference-class rival. Rejected reading: purely heuristic inquiry norm as the author’s full thesis, since §5.2 expressly defends descriptive reality. Also rejected: defeasibility alone as proof of explanatory adequacy or complete proof that a relevant exception exists. NONNECESSITATION: §4pp5–6 expressly denies that causes must be modally sufficient; §8.3pp14–15 distinguishes causing observations from explaining every correlation. §8.4pp15–16 represents agent-power/patient-liability facts as at least part of a cause and allows failed exercise with unchanged cause/concomitants. No whole-ground necessitation or collapse principle follows. §8.9pp17–19 separately proposes effect-to-cause identity/relative-necessity reasoning, not cause-to-effect necessitation; its merits remain open. Theorem1p9’s reference to Axiom1 as Veridicality is a numbering mismatch with §4’s Axiom5, retained as a locator issue rather than silently rewritten. No new source claims, bare statements, Lean/model, source kind/dependency, truth flags, owner selections or frontier closure are added. Existing web_snapshot/pdf_pages supports the fullpaper witness; copyrighted raw PDF/text remain ignored. Byte integrity identifies this consulted preprint, not source fidelity or philosophical soundness. New focused attempt stores substantive findings; it does not repair or broaden old Koons2001 claims. Offline source check passes469 passages/1822 claim bindings. Existing verify_all scoped to the single new passage completed33235 terminal0: one live web snapshot verified at the exact c0dba715d1e3 hash, all other468 witnesses offline-only; no old Koons2001 retry or full-live-source scan. Materialization and live verification are distinct successful operations, not proof of fidelity. Final cheap corpus40384 passes127sources/469passages/2656statements/1822claims/818results, with only the existing unrelated Frege–Geach warning. Focused JSON/whitespace checks pass. Claim/type self-sweep: no source claim or Lean binding added; all locators use preprint pagination, primary fact/event domain, boxed A4 and default/exception scopes remain explicit; no modal-collapse/individualization or source-truth upgrade follows. All three new owned records are ready for coordinator fidelity review/staging; no shared index or other file was staged. Coordinator independently read the complete materialized26page witness (first35000chars plus remainder) and allthree source/passage/attempt records; accepts precise preprint provenance, hashes, page numbering and scope audit with no findings. Important distinction preserved: §4Axiom7 is a UNIVERSAL formal statement; §5.1 separately supplies a default-connective alternative and epistemic defense, not proof of actual exceptions or permission to silently weaken the axiom itself. Under a defended possible-facts Ontic interpretation its logical shape matches actual no-necessary-parts causal coverage; that does not establish the universal policy from the default license. §8.11pp19–20 exempts mixed contingent facts with necessary components from wholly-contingent scope; this is compatible with JointCondition.contingent (a mixed fixed conjunction can remain contingent), but no identity of conjunction with concrete fusion is inferred. Under no actual NE plus actual-part existence the whole-route proof makes all actual candidates no-necessary-parts, so mixed facts cannot evade that reductio by already containing an actual necessary part. §3Axiom4 provides one-way boxed whole-to-part actuality, not by itself converse all-members-to-fusion actuality; prose calling aggregation conjunctive may motivate an additional semantic reconstruction, which remains explicit rather than a proved source-axiom consequence. §7Corollary1 needs additional fact-involvement/bearer-realization correspondence; mathematical NecessaryBeing on a facts carrier is not automatically a necessary individual-substance conclusion. No source falsehood, model, journal-edition equivalence, new claim or CFtruth closure is asserted. All verifiedrawbytes remain ignored; only three metadata records are staged. Follow-up warrant-transfer audit distinguishes three commitments: strict universalA7/CF3; defeasible empirical warrant for believing that universal; and §5.1p6 object-level normal causal default absent contrary evidence. They are not interchangeable. Source §6.2places independent actual-wholly-contingent-cosmos lemmas before default causal application, while our reducedactualfusion/cover reductio classifies the selectedwhole only under scoped denialofNE. Applying a default under that hypothesis and discharging it classically requires an independently specified hypothetical/nonmonotonic warrant-and-defeater policy; existing A10 records preserve defeasibility but contain no checked rule authorizing this transfer. The same hypothetical background yields a classical obstruction to a cause, whose treatment depends on the chosen defaultlogic. This is neither a formal bug in the strictCF3Leanconsequence nor a categorical refutation of any defeasible cosmological argument. Alternatives remain: defend strictCF3 as a working universal; justify default-through-hypothesis; or independently establish the actual qualifying totality before applying the source default. No philosophicalpremise is discharged. Independent fixed-constituent reuse audit: NecessaryFactBoundary.lawControl already witnesses necessary fact without any necessary ordinary being under its weaker assumptions; this is not a countermodel to Corollary1 with its added constitution commitments. No general fixed-constituent transfer consumer was found. PSRStrength.Coherent ties designated existence facts to ordinary existence at each world; PositiveTargetCoherent plus AutonomousGroundNecessity.necessaryTarget concerns the SAME designated being and additionally requires autonomy/necessitation, so cannot consume an arbitrary necessary source fact. ExistenceIngredient gives labels, not realization; rigid designation laws require explicit cross-world correspondence. A bounded future consumer can use a genuine existing Arena A, actual necessary fact f, a fixed nonempty set S of ordinary beings, and all-world factivity: every member of S exists whenever the SAME f obtains. Choosing one member once yields actual and necessary existence without exchanging box-exists for exists-box or adding frame axioms. These fixed constituent/factivity/frame correspondences remain OPEN. Owner actual-being population transfers to actual facts only with a genuine existence-fact coherence dictionary; a constructor/tag does not establish obtaining. No code, phantom Model, proof, new source attribution or premise discharge follows from this audit. Public delivery integrated from reviewed main: #875 first unity source reading merged ec230bdd40b9def01998c746f32dee148910fd16; #876 primary preprint pin merged dcc43d440a64ada026fb1177b95e54e534e2aa7d. Canonical later readings and independent audit retained; exhausted unity candidate remains retired. Follow-up read-only backlog/reuse audit: open issues #545, #750 and #311 distinguish jointly indispensable contributors from individual sufficiency, independent explanatory relevance from modal necessitation, and local transmission from whole explanation. JointGroups.Exercise.jointlySufficient concerns the whole contributor/enabler set; group membership alone asserts no individual sufficiency or actual exercise. DerivativeJointPower Supply/Escape separates productive supply from local occurrence/coherence. ConcreteExistentialSupply.necessaryConcreteOfSupply already composes supply with contingent dependence and excluded middle into necessary concrete existence, but supplyRootEquivalence makes its application premise equivalent to actual concrete root existence; citing that equivalence is not independent warrant. The remaining CF3/CF5p application bridge must concern the SAME actual complete existential cause of the SAME cover: strict coverage for ordinary partial contributors does not establish coverage for complete existential production, while defining completeness as external would relocate the nonparthood commitment. Complete explanation need not necessitate an effect. No checked application bridge was found in this bounded audit; no corpus-wide absence claim or premise discharge is made. Root independently inspected supplyRootEquivalence and necessaryConcreteOfSupply before preserving this finding.

BOUNDED COROLLARY1 PRIMARY EXTRACTION (2026-11-01): Full pinned26page preprint rematerialized/read in sequential chunks; §3pp3–5 and §7Cor1pp9–10 read with Cor2–4 and §8.12p20 context. Five source claims/independent bare statements plus glossary/disambiguation distinguish fixed possible-fact domain/T/Barcan, explicitly presumed being/property involvement, explicitly assumed actual-involvement→actual-existence, inferred necessary-fact→necessary-being ORsystem, and selected cause-fact corollary. No journal pagination/edition identity is asserted. Fixed FACT domain does not by itself establish fixed ordinary constituent bearer across worlds. The source Hence presupposes that interpretation for a de-re bearer transfer rather than supplying a separate derivation. §8.12 same verifier/instance argument supports local existential instantiation, not a fixed n across worlds; §7Cor3–4 invokes included attributes/parts without independent constituent rigidity proof. Existing Results.Explanation.FixedConstituentNecessaryBeing.sameBearer/necessaryBeingOfFact/necessaryBeing are the positive checked consumer with actual+necessary fact, fixed nonempty K and all-world realization; no source claim is bound by fiat to AccountConstituentsNonempty/Realized heads. The generic source involvement/being-property claim does not automatically establish every assigned K member’s realization or ordinary Ontic/cause dictionary. Source T supplies reflexivity context while the consumer retains actual truth separately. Calling a being/system God is not a signature/uniqueness proof. Rejected fixed-domain→fixed-bearer and necessary-fact-alone→necessary-individual readings; no new Lean, pin, axiom, inference/model or premise truth/closure. Source-only fixed-domain and involvement glosses are separate so the new disambiguation does not reinterpret existing analyst K heads or require old proof records to adopt source semantics. Focused corpus/source manifest-binding checks PASS (2720 statements,1882 claims,469 passages; existing unrelated Frege-Geach warning only), whitespace PASS. Claim/type self-sweep preserves independent statement identity, presumed/assumed versus inferred commitments, being-or-system scope and no source-to-K fiat binding. No premise change or discharge.
